worldcombat.skill.holdback.summary: Sweeps a restrained arc in front: every non-ally in the fan is only chipped and left with at least 1 HP. Braced is wider and heavier but plants the user; Quick is faster and lighter.
worldcombat.skill.holdback.use.0: Chip several targets down to low HP for capture at once
worldcombat.skill.holdback.use.1: Suppress a melee without knocking anyone out
worldcombat.skill.holdback.use.2: Keep foes alive for allies and control the field
worldcombat.skill.holdback.use.3: Keep a clustered group alive in one sweep
worldcombat.skill.holdback.description.0: The sweep deals about %1$s damage; if that would be lethal it is capped so the target keeps at least 1 HP. The target's defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.holdback.description.1: The sweep reaches about %1$s blocks with a hit fan opening about %2$s degrees, running from the feet up to about %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.holdback.description.2: Braced plants the user for about %1$s after the sweep, unable to move during that time; Quick has no such plant and can move right after.
worldcombat.skill.holdback.option.on: Braced: power about x1.2, reach +0.3 blocks and fan +8 degrees, at wind-up +4 and cooldown +6 ticks and a planted brace after the sweep - for covering several thick targets at once.
worldcombat.skill.holdback.option.off: Quick: power about x0.85, a faster cast and free movement right after - for staying mobile in a melee.
worldcombat.skill.holdback.timing: Sweep up to %1$s blocks away; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.holdback.growth.0: At level %1$s the sweep rises to %2$s power and the fan to %3$s degrees half-angle.
worldcombat.skill.holdback.preference.he: On: power about x1.2, reach +0.3 blocks and fan +8 degrees, at wind-up +4 and cooldown +6 ticks and a planted brace (see Brace duration) after the sweep - for covering several thick targets at once. Off (Quick): power about x0.85, a faster cast and free movement right after - for staying mobile in a melee. Neither version can knock a target out.
worldcombat.skill.holdback.preference.ai: The companion only offers the sweep at a threat this close; higher lets it step in further before sweeping.
On: scores one tier higher when two or more enemies are in front, chipping a whole group at once; off: ranked as an ordinary melee move.
world_combat.move.holdback.text.spare: Force held back - at least 1 HP
worldcombat.skill.holdback.description.a: Every non-ally caught in the fan is swept exactly once - there is no target limit - and each one is left with at least 1 HP, so the move spares several targets at once.
